prompt: I want to add a weekly calendar view to this app. What files do I need to create or modify, and which libraries/patterns should I use?

assertions.description: Mentions the Zustand calendarStore and the WEEKLY mode value
References src/components/DailyView/ as the pattern/template to follow
Mentions Day.js for week-range date calculations
Suggests creating the component under src/components/ (e.g. WeeklyView/)
Recommends Ant Design for UI components
